subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What exact pre-auth Control UI diagnostic contents may be displayed and copied before the Gateway connection is authenticated?
rationale: The feature is useful for support, but only maintainers can set the security/product boundary for redaction, retention, and whether handshake/auth/device details may appear before auth succeeds.

options.title: Sanitized Client Transcript
options.body: Expose lifecycle phases, safe detail codes, close codes/reasons, and recovery hints in memory only, excluding raw frames, credentials, signatures, nonces, and unredacted endpoint secrets.

options.title: Authenticated Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep the disconnected gate limited to recovery guidance and add richer logs only after an authenticated connection can authorize diagnostics such as logs.tail.

options.title: No Debug Mode
options.body: Keep the current categorized login errors and require CLI/server-side diagnostics for deeper support cases.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Client Transcript
recommendation.body: Expose lifecycle phases, safe detail codes, close codes/reasons, and recovery hints in memory only, excluding raw frames, credentials, signatures, nonces, and unredacted endpoint secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across the Control UI connection, login, and debug files involved in the decision.
